mergedParams.userDescription: Floating text elements, slow drift and fade animation.

output.title: Floating Text with Slow Drift & Fade Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a preset for ethereal floating text elements that drift like clouds across the screen with a dreamy, cinematic quality. As a video editor, imagine text layers that slowly move through 3D space with subtle parallax - some closer and faster, others distant and slower. Each text element should have its own drift trajectory using smooth sine-wave motion paths, creating organic movement patterns. The fade animation should be gradual and atmospheric, like fog rolling in and out. Include gentle rotation on the Z-axis (1-3 degrees) to enhance the floating sensation. Consider using multiple text elements at different depths to create a layered, dimensional effect. The overall timing should feel meditative and hypnotic, with staggered start times for each element to avoid synchronized movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' as container. Create 3-5 TextAtom components, each wrapped in BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning. Initial positions: spread across viewport using Tailwind classes like 'top-1/4 left-1/3', 'bottom-1/3 right-1/4'. Apply generic keyframe effects with translateX and translateY using sine-wave calculations (Math.sin for organic motion). Animation duration: 15-20 seconds per cycle with different durations for each element. Opacity effects: 0 to 1 over 2 seconds fade-in, maintain full opacity, then 1 to 0 over 3 seconds fade-out. Use 'ease-in-out' easing for all animations. Add subtle rotate effect (-3 to 3 degrees) with longer duration (25-30 seconds). Performance: use 'will-change-transform will-change-opacity' classes. Consider fitDurationTo: 'children' for automatic duration calculation.

prompts.prompt: Design a preset for text elements that float upward like bubbles or smoke particles, with physics-based motion. From a motion graphics perspective, think of After Effects particle systems where text elements rise with slight wobble and acceleration changes. Each text should start from the bottom with random horizontal positions and float upward with varying speeds based on 'weight' - smaller text floats faster, larger text slower. Add horizontal drift using Perlin noise-like patterns for realistic turbulence. The fade should simulate dissipation - text becomes more transparent as it rises, eventually disappearing completely near the top. Include subtle scale changes (growing slightly as they rise) to enhance the bubble effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full'. Use repeatChildrenProps to generate multiple TextAtom instances with randomized initial positions using 'absolute bottom-0' and dynamic left positioning (calculate percentages based on index). Implement upward movement with translateY from 0 to -120vh over staggered durations (8-15 seconds based on fontSize). Add translateX with oscillating values (-50px to 50px) using multiple keyframes for wobble effect. Opacity animation: 1 at bottom, 0.8 at 25%, 0.5 at 50%, 0 at 80% of height. Scale effect: 1 to 1.2 over animation duration. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' for natural acceleration. Apply blur effect from 0 to 2px in final 20% for dissipation. Consider using internal effect presets for reusable bubble-float behavior.

prompts.prompt: Build a preset for text elements that float in a circular carousel pattern with depth-based fading. Picture a video editing setup where text orbits around an invisible center point, moving closer and farther from the viewer. As text moves to the back of the circle, it fades and scales down; as it comes forward, it brightens and enlarges. This creates a 3D carousel effect using 2D transforms. Each text element should maintain consistent angular velocity but with phase offsets to distribute them evenly. Add subtle vertical floating (like objects in zero gravity) overlaid on the circular motion. The fade animation should be tied to the Z-position simulation - maximum opacity when closest to viewer.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center'. Position TextAtoms using absolute positioning with 'top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2' for center origin. Use transform-origin center. Apply circular motion using combined translateX (Math.cos) and translateY (Math.sin) calculations with radius of 200-300px. Implement z-index changes based on Y position (higher Y = higher z-index). Opacity varies from 0.3 (back) to 1 (front) synchronized with Y position. Scale from 0.7 (back) to 1.2 (front). Add secondary translateY animation (-20px to 20px) over 4 seconds for floating effect. Full rotation duration: 20-30 seconds per element with staggered start times. Use 'linear' easing for rotation, 'ease-in-out' for floating. Consider dependencies for a reusable circular-motion helper.

prompts.prompt: Create a preset for text elements that drift horizontally like end credits with depth layers and atmospheric haze. Envision a cinematic title sequence where text moves laterally across the screen at different speeds based on depth - foreground text moves faster, background slower (parallax scrolling). Each layer should have different opacity levels to simulate atmospheric perspective. Add subtle vertical bobbing to make the motion feel less mechanical. The fade effect should be distance-based: text fades in from the edge of the screen and fades out on the opposite edge, with additional opacity reduction for deeper layers. Include optional blur for background layers to enhance depth perception.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create 3-4 depth layers using nested BaseLayouts with different z-index values (z-10, z-20, z-30). Foreground TextAtoms: translateX from 100vw to -100vw over 10 seconds, opacity 1, scale 1.2, className 'text-6xl font-bold'. Mid-ground: translateX over 15 seconds, opacity 0.7, scale 1, className 'text-4xl font-medium'. Background: translateX over 25 seconds, opacity 0.4, scale 0.8, className 'text-2xl font-light', add blur(1px) filter. Vertical float: translateY -10px to 10px over 3-5 seconds with 'ease-in-out'. Edge fading: opacity 0 at 0%, 1 at 15%, 1 at 85%, 0 at 100% of horizontal travel. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' for automatic timing adjustment.

prompts.prompt: Design a preset for text that floats like dandelion seeds or feathers in a gentle breeze. From an animator's view, imagine lightweight text elements that respond to invisible wind currents - sudden lifts, gentle falls, and swirling patterns. Each text should have its own 'weight' affecting how it responds to the wind. The movement should feel organic and unpredictable, using compound curves and varying speeds. Implement rotation on multiple axes for tumbling effects. The fade animation should simulate distance - text becomes smaller and more transparent as it 'floats away'. Include occasional 'gusts' where all text temporarily speeds up and changes direction.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full'. TextAtoms with random initial positions using 'absolute' and calculated top/left percentages. Primary motion: Bezier curve paths using translateX and translateY with multiple keyframes (at least 8-10 points) for organic trajectories. Wind simulation: base drift translateX 0 to 300px, with periodic 'gust' acceleration (scale transform values by 1.5x for 1-2 seconds). Vertical motion: sine wave pattern translateY with amplitude 50-100px, frequency varying by element 'weight'. Rotation: rotateZ -180 to 180 degrees over 15 seconds, rotateX -30 to 30 degrees for tumbling. Scale animation: 1 to 0.5 as 'distance' increases. Opacity: 1 to 0 tied to scale changes. Use spring easing for gusts, ease-in-out for regular motion. Consider waveform effects if audio is present for wind-synchronized movement.

prompts.prompt: Build a preset for text elements that float in a zen garden water ripple pattern. Picture text as lily pads on a pond surface, gently bobbing and drifting with concentric ripple effects. Each text element should have subtle undulation (vertical movement) simulating water surface tension. The drift should follow spiral patterns emanating from a center point, like ripples spreading outward. Add slight rotation that follows the ripple direction. The fade effect should be gradual and peaceful - text materializes like morning mist and dissipates like evening fog. Include synchronized pulsing where all elements briefly brighten together, simulating droplets hitting the water surface.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden'. Position TextAtoms in concentric circles using polar coordinates (convert to translateX/Y). Ripple motion: radial expansion from center using increasing radius over time (0 to 400px over 20 seconds). Spiral component: add rotating angle (0 to 360 degrees) combined with radial expansion. Vertical bobbing: translateY -5px to 5px with sine wave, phase offset based on distance from center. Rotation: subtle rotateZ following tangent angle of spiral. Opacity: fade in 0 to 0.9 over 3 seconds, maintain, fade out 0.9 to 0 over 4 seconds. Pulse effect: brief opacity boost to 1 every 5 seconds (synchronized across all elements) using internal effect preset. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.6, 1)' for smooth water-like motion.

prompts.prompt: Create a preset for text that floats like autumn leaves falling in slow motion. Think of a high-speed camera capturing leaves descending - each with unique tumbling patterns, occasional updrafts, and sideways drift. Text elements should spiral downward with varying speeds and rotation rates. Some should pause mid-fall, caught in an updraft, before continuing. The movement should combine pendulum swings (back and forth) with overall downward progression. Add 3D rotation for realistic tumbling. The fade animation should make text appear to fall into and out of a depth of field, with middle-range text being sharpest and edge text being softer and more transparent.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Generate TextAtoms with 'absolute -top-20' initial positions, distributed horizontally. Falling motion: translateY from -100px to 120vh over 12-20 seconds (varied per element). Pendulum swing: translateX using sine function, amplitude 100-150px, frequency based on 'leaf weight'. Tumbling: rotateZ 0 to 720 degrees, rotateY 0 to 360 degrees over fall duration. Updraft simulation: at random keyframe (40-60%), pause translateY and reduce by 50px over 1 second, then resume. Depth of field: blur filter 2px at start, 0px at 50% height, 3px at bottom. Opacity: 0.5 at top, 1 at middle, 0.3 at bottom. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' for slight bounce on updrafts. Consider using sub-presets for individual leaf behavior patterns.

prompts.prompt: Design a preset for text floating in a space/starfield environment with subtle parallax and glow effects. Visualize text as celestial objects drifting through space at different distances. Closer text should move faster across the screen with stronger glow, distant text slower with softer luminance. Add gentle pulsing to simulate stellar brightness variations. Include slow rotation as if objects are tumbling through zero gravity. The drift should be primarily horizontal but with slight vertical variance. Fade animation should simulate moving through a nebula - text emerges from cosmic dust (blur and low opacity) and returns to it.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create 4-5 depth layers for parallax. Near text: 'absolute z-50 text-white', translateX -100vw to 100vw over 8 seconds, scale 1.5, textShadow '0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'. Mid text: z-30, translateX over 15 seconds, scale 1, textShadow '0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'. Far text: z-10, translateX over 30 seconds, scale 0.7, textShadow '0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'. Add glow pulse using opacity 0.7 to 1 over 2-3 seconds (loop). Rotation: rotateZ -180 to 180 over 40 seconds, rotateY -90 to 90 over 30 seconds. Nebula fade: blur 5px to 0px for fade-in, 0px to 8px for fade-out, combined with opacity changes. Vertical drift: translateY -30px to 30px over 10 seconds. Consider internal glow-pulse effect preset.

prompts.prompt: Build a preset for text that floats like underwater bubbles with caustic light effects. Imagine text suspended in water, gently rising while swaying with invisible currents. Each text element should have a wobbling motion as it ascends, with speed variations simulating water resistance. Add shimmer effects to simulate light refracting through water. The movement should include figure-8 patterns for realistic underwater drift. Text should occasionally cluster together then separate, like bubbles merging and splitting. The fade effect should simulate depth - text becomes hazier and bluer as it moves away from the viewing plane.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' with optional blue gradient background. TextAtoms positioned 'absolute bottom-0' with random left positions. Upward motion: translateY 100vh to -100px over 15-25 seconds with varying speeds. Figure-8 pattern: combine translateX using sin(t) and translateX using sin(2t) with different amplitudes (50px and 25px). Wobble: scale 0.95 to 1.05 over 1 second (loop). Caustic shimmer: animate brightness filter 100% to 130% over 0.5 seconds with random delays. Water color shift: add blue tint using filter 'hue-rotate(10deg) saturate(0.8)' for distant elements. Opacity: 0.6 at bottom (deep), 1 at middle (optimal viewing), 0.4 at top (surface distortion). Clustering: use conditional positioning - if two elements are within 100px, apply attractive force (reduce translateX difference by 50% for 2 seconds). Use 'cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)' for water resistance feel.

prompts.prompt: Create a preset for text that drifts like windswept desert sand with particle dispersion effects. Picture text as sand formations being gradually eroded and reformed by wind. Start with solid text that slowly breaks apart into smaller particles (use character-level or word-level splits) that drift away. The main text body should have slow lateral movement while edge characters/words peel off and accelerate. Add turbulence to the drifting particles - circular eddies and sudden direction changes. The fade animation should simulate sand particles becoming too small to see - gradual size reduction combined with opacity loss. Include periodic 'sand storm' moments where all elements temporarily speed up and blur.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. For particle effect, use word-level typography with caption data if available, otherwise split TextAtom into individual character BaseLayouts. Main text: 'absolute' positioning, translateX 0 to 200px over 20 seconds. Edge particles: detect words/characters at string edges, apply accelerated translateX (up to 500px) and translateY (-100px to 100px) with exponential acceleration. Turbulence: add rotational movement using rotate and circular translateX/Y patterns (radius 20-50px) for peeling particles. Sand storm effect: every 8-10 seconds, multiply all transform values by 3x for 1 second, add blur(3px). Dispersion fade: scale from 1 to 0.3, opacity 1 to 0 over 5 seconds for particles. Use 'steps(8)' easing for stuttered/granular movement on particles. Main text opacity: maintain 0.8-1. Consider dependencies for particle system helper. If using caption data, trigger particle release based on word timing.
